A Hunta Rig is equipped with: 'Eavy lobba; Savage horns and hooves; Stikka kannon.
AT(2), Add +1 for to hit rolls against Monstrous creatures and Vehicles
• Has access to vehicle equipment from the Armory.
Snagged: Vehicles and Monstrous creatures hit by the Stikka kannon can't move more than 6" away from the Hunta Rig until it is activated again.
Transport: This model has a transport capacity of 15 infantry models.
Wildork: The model receives the <Wildork> keyword and a 6+ ward saving throw. Melee hit rolls against vehicles or monstrous creatures receive a +1 bonus and the "Lance(1)" ability.
